newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: INSIGHT-Australian All Industrials still looking bullish.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT-Australian All Industrials still looking bullish.

text.p: ---------------Analysis by Daniel Fock - June 3-------------
*Rally set to continue.
*Index towards top of medium term bull channel.
*Index looking very overbought in all time frames.
*All Industrials index closed at 4,089.4 on Monday
The Australian All Industrials index has hit a new high and finished on that note.
These are all very positive indications, however, the index is overbought and overextended, so traders should exercise caution.
While the bull channels and support hold, traders are likely to remain bullish.
However, technicals are overbought so trailing stops will continue to protect profits when the index retraces.
Short term technicals are bullish. Moving averages are all bullish and leading indicators are continuing higher into overbought regions.
In trending markets the leaders can remain overbought, so wait for confirmation of a falling indicator or price.
Short term Fibonacci retracements are 4,015, 3,992 adn 3,969.
In the medium term, the index is higher again into new territory.
Traders are concerned about a blow-off top because the index remains extended and overbought.
While 4,000 and 3,980 hold, traders are likely to be cautiously bullish.
Medium term technicals are bullish and overbought.
The averages remain bullish, leading indicators are extremely overbought and climbing except the ROC which is off its high.
Traders will be increasingly anxious if the other indicators follow. Current Fibonacci retracements are 3,923, 3,872, and 3,821.

In the longer term, the index is also making new highs and is above last month's high. Longer term traders are likely to watch as the month unfolds. They too will become anxious about an consolidation or retracement.
Longer term technicals are bullish and very overbought.
Leading indicators are overbought and higher, except for the ROC which is lower.
Bollinger Bands in all time frames are showing overextensions. Traders are set to remain cautious bulls.
Overall bull channels remain intact and prices continue making new highs.
Leading indicators are very overbought, but this is normal in strong trending markets.
However, this is not an excuse to remove caution from the trading strategy.
Traders remain cautiously bullish.
As the bull trend continues higher, the chances of a retracement or consolidation increase.
Seasoned traders are staying with the trend but will continue to use trailling stops.
Key levels remain at 4,000, 3,980, and 3,915.
(Daniel Fock is a member of the Australian Technical Analysis Association. Views are his own.)
--Sydney newsroom 61-2 9373-1800
